newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Kredietbank raises Banka Hana stake - BH.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank raises Banka Hana stake - BH.

text.p: Belgium's Kredietbank NV has raised its stake in Czech Banka Hana a.s.(BH) to 18.8 percent, a press official for BH said on Tuesday.
The official said Kredietbank, as expected, had fully participated in a 900 million crown rights issue that closed at the end of February.
Kredietbank officials were not immediately available for comment.
Banka Hana officials said all major shareholders took part in the issue, which raised the bank's basic capital to 2.7 billion crowns.
Kredietbank officials have said that under a 1995 agreement, the Belgian bank may raise its stake to up to 30 percent.

Banka Hana, which is headquartered in the Moravian city of Olomouc, said it needed to raise its basic capital to raise funds to finance trading activities, and strengthen its capital adequacy and credibility among clients.
